raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "have better roaming in Romania"
      role subject ?carrier
      role destination "Romania"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "compare"
      role object "AT&T"
      role object "T-Mobile"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "a tourist from Texas"
  role object "the user"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation
